overview_description.description: Care Revolutions is a marketplace for healthcare staff, an online technology platform where Hospitals and Outpatient facilities can directly access per diem medical staff. No vendors, no agencies, no middlemen. Care Revolutions fill empty shifts faster, lower overall staffing costs, and increase trust and quality of patient care. Hospitals and outpatient facilities book professionals daily to complement their float pool, increase shift fill rates, and maintain safe nurse-to-patient ratios.

about_short_description.short_description: CareRev is a healthcare staffing marketplace platform that connects health systems and local healthcare professionals.

product.name: CareRev Marketplace
product.description: A healthcare staffing marketplace that connects hospitals and other care facilities with vetted local W-2 nurses and allied health professionals for on-demand shifts.

product.name: IRP+
product.description: An internal resource pool and workforce planning solution that helps health systems forecast demand, optimize internal float pools, and fill staffing needs with employees before using external labor.

product.name: CareRev Enterprise Tools
product.description: A set of workforce management tools for forecasting demand, modeling labor costs, optimizing float pools, monitoring staffing activity, and supporting governance and compliance.

identifier.value: CareRev VMS Integration and Partner Platform

product.name: CareRev VMS Integration and Partner Platform
product.description: An integration service that connects CareRev’s on-demand clinician marketplace with vendor management systems, enabling partners to post shifts and access qualified healthcare professionals.

identifier.value: Healthcare Professional Shift and Credentialing Service

product.name: Healthcare Professional Shift and Credentialing Service
product.description: A service for healthcare professionals to create profiles, complete screening and credentialing, find local per diem shifts, manage schedules, and receive payment through the CareRev platform.
